title: Quercetin attenuates Pseudomonas aeruginosa-induced acute lung inflammation by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Jia, Xiaolei; Gu, Mengdi; Dai, Jiangqin; Wang, Jue; Zhang, Yingying; Pang, Zheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素抑制铜绿假单胞菌诱导的急性肺部炎症，涉及PI3K/AKT/NF-kB信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa is an opportunistic pathogen that commonly causes infections in immunocompromised individuals with significant morbidity and mortality. Quercetin is a natural flavonoid abundantly present in fruits and vegetables, exerting potent anti-inflammatory effects in treatment of various diseases. However, the molecular mechanisms of quercetin in treatment of P. aeruginosa-induced acute lung inflammation are unclear. In this study, we exploited network pharmacology- and molecular docking-based approach to explore the potential mechanisms of quercetin against P. aeruginosa pneumonia, which was further validated via in vivo and in vitro experiments. The in vivo experiments demonstrated that quercetin alleviated the P. aeruginosa-induced lung injury by diminishing neutrophil infiltration and production of proinflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF), which was associated with decreased mortality. Moreover, the quercetin-treated mice displayed decreased phosphorylation levels of PI3K, AKT, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65 in lung tissues compared to non-drug-treated mice. Similarly, the in vitro study showed that the phosphorylation of these regulatory proteins and production of the proinflammatory cytokines were impaired in the quercetin-pretreated macrophages upon P. aeruginosa infection. Altogether, this study suggested that quercetin reduced the P. aeruginosa-induced acute lung inflammation by suppressing PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌是一种机会性病原体，常见于免疫功能低下个体中引起感染，并伴随显著的发病率和死亡率。槲皮素是一种天然类黄酮，广泛存在于水果和蔬菜中，在多种疾病的治疗中发挥强效抗炎作用。然而，槲皮素治疗铜绿假单胞菌诱导的急性肺部炎症的分子机制尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用基于网络药理学和分子对接的方法探讨槲皮素对抗铜绿假单胞菌肺炎的潜在机制，并通过体内和体外实验进一步验证。体内实验表明，槲皮素通过减少中性粒细胞浸润和促炎细胞因子（IL-1β、IL-6和TNF）的产生，减轻了铜绿假单胞菌诱导的肺损伤，这与死亡率降低相关。此外，与未用药小鼠相比，槲皮素处理的小鼠肺组织中PI3K、AKT、IκBα和NF-κB p65的磷酸化水平降低。同样，体外研究显示，在铜绿假单胞菌感染时，槲皮素预处理的巨噬细胞中这些调节蛋白的磷酸化及促炎细胞因子的产生受到抑制。总体而言，本研究提示槲皮素通过抑制PI3K/AKT/NF-κB信号通路减轻了铜绿假单胞菌诱导的急性肺部炎症。
